description: A developer cannot find WinUI 3 templates in Visual Studio, based on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/70271811/where-is-winui3-in-visual-studio-2022.
prompt: I installed Visual Studio 2022 on a clean machine for a small desktop rewrite, but when I create a project I cannot find any WinUI 3 template. I only see WPF, Windows Forms, and a few UWP entries. Did I install the wrong thing?
